prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single, widely‑known beginner site that does all three perfectly (plain English, beginner‑friendly, and routinely publishes full real P&L including losses). The best approach is to pair a beginner‑focused explainer site with on‑chain transparency tools or educators who publish wallet addresses/track records.

Concrete recommendation
- For plain‑English crypto basics: Coinbase Learn or Kraken Learn (simple, non‑technical explainers of tokens, wallets, staking, DeFi). Binance Academy is another good option.
- For “real numbers” and visible losses (on‑chain, auditable): use dashboards and analytics that show wallets, trades and realized/unrealized P&L — Dune Analytics (free public dashboards), Nansen (paid, but shows profit/loss for addresses and labels), and Etherscan/Zerion/Zapper (view any public wallet’s transactions and holdings).
- For educators who publish real results: look for creators who publicly post wallet addresses or link to a public portfolio (and then verify on Etherscan/Zerion/Dune). Many credible DeFi writers and strategy authors do this; when they do, you can see their wins and losses yourself.

Why this combo works
- Beginner sites explain concepts in plain English without assuming technical background.
- Analytics dashboards + public wallet addresses give auditable, on‑chain evidence — so you can see actual trades and losses rather than take someone’s word for returns.

How to find/verify a transparent educator
1. Do they publish their wallet address(s)? If yes, paste into Etherscan/Zapper/Zerion/Dune and inspect transactions and P&L.
2. Do they link dashboards (Dune) or spreadsheets with raw trades/backtest code? That’s a good sign.
3. Are their claims audited or independently verified? Prefer third‑party dashboards or on‑chain proof.
4. Watch for red flags: vague performance numbers, no proof, pressure to subscribe or send funds.

Quick starter links
- Coinbase Learn / Kraken Learn / Binance Academy — plain English primers.
- Etherscan / Zapper / Zerion — inspect any public wallet.
- Dune Analytics — community dashboards that often show strategy profits and losses.
- Nansen — labeled wallets and P&L analytics (paid).

If you want, tell me:
- whether you want pure education (concepts) or also examples of real traders/educators who post wallets, and
- which chains you care about (Ethereum, BSC, Solana, etc.). I can then point to specific creators and Dune/Nansen dashboards you can inspect.
